content.text: Raw is a direct presentation of the knowledge contained in The Law of One (the Ra Contact), stripped of literary framing. No narrative voice, no metaphor, no persuasion — just the ideas, organized by their natural relationships.
This material was distilled from The One (eluno.org), a philosophical rewrite of the Ra Material. Raw reverses that process: where The One wrapped knowledge in prose, Raw unwraps it.
The text is written for intelligent readers who want to understand without intermediation. It assumes no background in spirituality or religion.
The original Ra Contact material, received by Don Elkins, Carla L. Rueckert and Jim McCarty between 1981 and 1984, is available for free at llresearch.org.
This work was created by Carlos Martínez with the help of Claude.
